pages.title: Polymerase
pages.text: $(thing)Polymerase$(): An enzyme that works the double helix: it walks to the nearest one, climbs it rung by rung reading the strand and laying down a copy behind it, turns at the top and works back down. Knocked off, it climbs back on. Harmless. Found in the Nucleus of Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Drops$(): Nucleotide, Messenger RNA.
